references.description: Competitor carousel image 1 of 7, from the Macorner PDP.
references.prompt:
Create one premium e-commerce PDP image for Brushed Paws. This is image 1 of 7 in the Pet Memorial Ceramic Planter carousel (scene: "Competitor carousel image 1 of 7").

REFERENCE HIERARCHY
1. Use the attached competitor scene reference only for composition, camera position, crop, visual rhythm, lighting logic, body pose and product-to-frame ratio.
2. Use the separately attached Pet Memorial Ceramic Planter Product Master photographs as the sole authority for the product itself.
3. If the two references conflict, the Product Master always wins for every physical product detail.

ART DIRECTION
Reproduce the composition, camera framing, crop, lighting direction and mood of the attached competitor reference image (scene: "Competitor carousel image 1 of 7", from Macorner). Build a premium, confident visual language for Brushed Paws. The image should feel refined and intentional, never juvenile, overly technical or generic-dropship. Use the Brushed Paws palette naturally: #4A5A6A as the primary brand color, #FBF6EF as a clean neutral background, #6E8F6F as a controlled accent (CTAs, highlights), #C9825B only as a small pop of color (never dominating the frame).

PRODUCT FIDELITY
Preserve the exact Pet Memorial Ceramic Planter silhouette, materials, hardware, seams, colors and proportions shown in the separate Pet Memorial Ceramic Planter Product Master photographs. Show A small ceramic planter with their portrait and name, for a plant that grows where they used to sit.. Do not add, remove, enlarge or redesign any functional element. Do not invent pockets, closures, certifications, labels, textures, seams or accessories beyond what the Product Master shows. Maintain plausible scale, gravity, tension, material behavior and contact shadows.

BRAND AND LEGAL CLEANUP
Remove all competitor logos, trademarks, distinctive competitor prints, patches, watermarks and readable brand text from the reference. Do not imitate proprietary artwork, mascots or packaging design. Apply only the approved Brushed Paws identity when a brand mark is genuinely visible and physically plausible. Do not place promotional copy, prices, reviews or unverified technical claims inside the image.

QUALITY CONTROL
Photorealistic commercial photography, natural anatomy, correct fingers/hands when present, realistic material response, accurate reflections, clean color separation, high micro-detail at the focal plane, restrained sharpening, no CGI gloss, no surreal elements and no visual clutter. Deliver a single finished image at 2048 x 2048 px (or 1600 x 2000 px for on-body lifestyle scenes), sRGB, with safe crop margins for mobile and desktop.
